rows.observation: 译文插入了「生命值回满时立即结束该模式」，但冻结源串 tome-orcs/data/timed_effects/other.lua:541（long_desc）中没有这层意思。源串只说明三点：无法行动；生命回复提高 %d、全部抗性提高 %d%%；生命降到 -%d 以下之前不会死亡。envelope 未提供结束条件的实现证据，DLC 来源也未固定。如果实现里并没有回满即结束的逻辑，这句就是添加的内容，需要宿主核验该效果或相关技能的实现。

rows.observation: 「Dominion Port」译为「巨魔帝国港口」，把 Dominion 具体化成了「巨魔」的帝国。冻结源码 tome-orcs/data/zones/dominion-port/zone.lua:21-27 只写 Dominion Port，没有任何 troll 含义；按 Embers of Rage 设定，Dominion 应指 Kar'Haïb Dominion，而非巨魔。envelope 未冻结对应的术语条目（terminology 为空），无法确认这是既定译名。该名还与同文件的 Sewers/Tower 子层名称共用，影响跨条一致性，需要宿主核对术语依据。

rows.observation: 源串 tome-orcs/data/talents/steam/automated-butchery.lua:176 写的是「increases your steam level by %d%% of the maximum」，即按蒸汽最大值的 %d%% 立即增加蒸汽；译文「直接恢复 %d%% 蒸汽值」丢了「of the maximum」这个计算基准，读者可能理解为按当前值或其他基数计算。建议写明「最大蒸汽值的 %d%%」。另外，结尾「！！」多了一个感叹号，源文只有一个「!」。

notes: Mixed main-game + Orcs batch: surface ran as one gpt-6-sol full-000 lane over the 2 main-game entries and four fresh Orcs lanes of 20/20/19/19. Every lane echoed its identities exactly. No lane opened a Paseo terminal or called any write tool.
The contextual run (7 Orcs entries; both main-game entries passed surface) read only its own envelope, the contract and the cited Orcs source. The host scanned its native log before harvest.

Source refutes three claims: the automated repair mode does end at full life (on_timeout), the Dominion is the troll Kar'Haïb Dominion that the library renders 卡尔·亥巴巨魔帝国, and the Forced Gestalt end message really restores strength. Two achievement-title tone notes stay advisory.
